data.long_meaning: The name Howell is derived from the Old English words ‘hoh’ meaning ‘smoke’ and ‘weal’ meaning ‘well’. It is a name that suggests a connection to the natural world, with the smoke perhaps representing the breath of life, and the well symbolizing the sustenance and nourishment that comes from the earth. The name Howell carries the meaning “Smoke and well” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Howell usually hope their child will grow to embody smoke and well and live with faith, good character and purpose.
